title: Carry Generate Combiner
statement: Implement an 8-bit carry generate and propagate unit that produces group generate and group propagate signals for a ripple-carry adder stage. The outputs should describe whether this block will generate a carry regardless of input carry, or propagate an input carry to the next stage. This combinational module is a datapath building block used in faster adder designs.
module_signature: module carry_generate_combiner(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output g, output p);
behavior: g is 1 when a+b will generate a carry within the block regardless of carry-in.
p is 1 when the block propagates a carry-in to carry-out.
The design must be purely combinational.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not instantiate a full adder array with registers.
hint: Use bitwise and/or reduction logic to capture generate and propagate behavior.
